`src/mem_mcp/mindmap/__init__.py` defines the constants governing mind maps (collaborative thinking trees layered over core memories), namely the default reviewer threshold of 15 writes, the 1200-char soft cap that suggests a node be split rather than trimmed, the permitted node roles (`position`, `challenge`, `note`), and the ordered ratification strength gradient. A short module docstring explains the data model: a map is a root memory whose slug is its identity, with node content in `memories`, edges in `memory_references`, and lifecycle state in `memory_maps`/`memory_map_membership`/`memory_map_events`.

`src/mem_mcp/config.py` builds a frozen Pydantic `Settings` model for all runtime config, sourcing values from AWS SSM Parameter Store (via a `SsmLoader` Protocol so tests can inject fakes) with an `MEM_MCP_SKIP_SSM` escape hatch that switches to env-only loading via `NullSsmLoader`. `get_settings()` is an `lru_cache`d singleton that merges SSM and `MEM_MCP_*` env values (env wins) into settings, and exposes a test-only `_reset_settings_cache_for_tests()` to drop that cache; a `db_*_dsn_asyncpg` property strips the SQLAlchemy `+psycopg` suffix so asyncpg can connect.
